h1: Custom Embroidery Badges for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom embroidery badges in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for uniforms, teams, and events. Start your quote today.
introHtml: Embroidered badges offer a classic, durable look that printed alternatives can't match. The raised thread texture adds depth and a premium feel, making them ideal for uniforms, team apparel, and corporate gifts. With tight stitch counts and vibrant thread colors, your logo stays sharp wash after wash. Perfect for marketing directors and HR managers seeking professional branding that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom embroidery badges featuring a corporate logo on a twill background with thread border
